messages.body_plain:
Hello,

Greetings of the day.

I am writing to introduce you to HaystackAnalytics. We are a healthtech company, incubated at SINE, IIT Bombay. We specialize in clinical genomics products that empower diagnostic labs and hospitals to provide precise, personalized diagnostics.

At HaystackAnalytics, we have honed our expertise in clinical genomics to establish a state-of-the-art sequencing facility. We're proud to offer these cutting-edge sequencing services now to support a wide range of businesses, researchers, and institutions.

We operate on shotgun and long-read sequencing platforms, ensuring flexibility and precision for all your genomic needs. We’re now offering these world-class services at highly competitive rates, tailored to support businesses and researchers in advancing their work.

Our Services:

Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS)

Whole Exome Sequencing (WES)

Metagenomics

Transcriptome Sequencing

Turnaround Time: 7-10 days

Apart from this, we have a range of clinical genomics products in our portfolio. We see many synergies and believe our partnership can drive innovative solutions.

We would love the opportunity to discuss how we can collaborate to deliver even more value to our customers and advance the future of genomics.

Looking forward to connecting with you.

Warm regards,

Inder Singh

Email ID - seque...@haystackanalytics.in

Contact Number - +91-9818374403

Website - https://haystackanalytics.in/

 India | Bahrain | Oman | Saudi Arabia | UAE
